description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe project addresses the urgent needs of Armed Conflicts and Cyclone Mocha affected people in 37 villages of three different townships, displaced people sheltered in 26 IDPs camps and 11 conflict affected vulnerable household’s villages in Falam, Hakha and Matupi townships through a humanitarian response planned with a coalition of local CSOs to provide beneficiaries with emergency support as well as durable solutions that are based on strengthening the role of women through the provision of Sheltering materials, NFI kits, Education, Protection and Health.ltbrgt The ultimate goal of the project is to save the lives of armed Conflicts and cyclone Mocha affected people and improve the living conditions of displaced and vulnerable people in Falam, Hakha and Matupi Townships Chin State and to strengthen their resilience so that people affected by the crisis can actively participate in promoting their common resilience and development with priority to Women, Youth and people with disabilities. EORE materials, Hygiene promotion activities, Emergency shelter kits, Hygiene kits, NFIs- Household items set, NFIs- Clothing sets, NFIs- Kitchen sets will be distributed through the project. ltbrgt Protection, the project will initiate with local organizations and women in the IDPs camps and increase their capacities on raising awareness on women rights, gender-based violence, women empowerment, creation of women-led community initiatives to address the women needs, women rights violations, gender-based violence and post-trauma support.ltbrgt Protection, the project will provide the educational awareness raising on EORE to IDPs, host community villages and schools by printing the IEC materials and providing the educational talking about the danger and preventing measures on unexploded ordnances and landmines by making sure no one left behind to reach this educational awareness raising programme in the areas. ltbrgt Education, the project will equip the learning spaces including students table, bench, blackboard, chalks, notebooks, pencils, pen, backpacks, schooling uniforms. Providing the capacity building, recruit and trained the quality educators through the provision of incentive payments to provide safe, relevant, accessible, quality, and inclusive non-formal education opportunities for all crisis and displacement-affected children and youth (ECCD, and basic education).ltbrgt Health, the project intends to provide basic primary health care services such as medication for fever, diarrhea, cough, minor wounds by recruiting medical doctors in each township. Moreover, the project will provide the health education talking at mobile clinic established under this project. ltbrgtThere are three IPs, Social Climber Society for Matupi Township, ENPO for Falam Township and Hakha Baptist Association for Hakha Township while MEET will be carried out the NFI/ Shelter, Education and Protection activities in all three townships and oversee the project from overall management and supervision roles. MEET had proper experiences in provision of educational talk on SRHR through the Access to Health fund and UNFPA and distribution of Hygiene Dignity kits. SCS had been providing the primary health care services for general medical treatment, fever, malaria wounds etc. through the medical doctors. HBA has been providing the traditional birth assistance services to communities as well as Para check services for Malaria testing. ENPO is being providing the health education knowledge to villagers on malaria, fever, minor disease and diarrhea etc.ltbrgtThe IPs SCS is going to provide the health activities Primary Health Care Services fixed and mobile clinics and health education talking in Matupi, ENPO is going to provide Health activities as PHC Services fixed and mobile clinics and health education talking in Falam and HBA is going to provide the health activities as PHC Services fixed and mobile clinics and health education talking in Hakha. ltbrgtlt/pgt
